_about: Table 4 of 6: mastery (#193). Mastery points build up on a particular item (fractional progress is kept and shown). Owner direction 2026-10-31: weapons earn mastery by fighting, armour by being struck. Caps per fight and a share for simply taking part keep 'take avoidable hits' from being the best way to progress. Proposals, not approved balance.

weapon_credit._about: Per action of the wielder, scaled by the foe's threat: threat_factor = clamp(foe threat / region_threat, 0.25, 2). region_threat is the region's usual foe threat (region table).

armour_credit._about: Per blow that reaches the wearer (blocked or not), scaled by the attacker's threat factor; plus a share for every fight the wearer stands in, so a careful player still progresses.

extraction._about: Bringing an item home: each worn item gains this on a successful return (not a wipe).

trivial_foes._about: Foes far below the region's level teach little.

catch_up._about: Practised hands: a new item learns faster while its level is this far below the best item of the same slot the hero owns.

smith_temper._about: At mastery 3 and 6 the smith turns mastery into one chosen improvement (#173), for gold and a regional material. The smith remembers improvements after the item is lost; rebuilding needs the investment again. Owner, 2026-10-31: tempering needs the item's own region's material, so old gear tops out.

options.text: +1 to the top of the damage range

_tuning: 2026-10-31: thresholds doubled after the first probe run (mastery 3 came in about 5 fights).
_decided: Owner, 2026-10-31: pace kept (mastery 3 in about 1.4 expeditions, 6 in about 4.3), tempering at 3 and 6.
